dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: This is terrible... What am I going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: It's my beacons! I've gone and left a whole load of them up on the mountain!

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: There's no way I can continue my research now... *sigh* And after all the money I spent on them, too...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What exactly happened?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Well, I wanted to do some research into conditions on the mountain — the climate, the environment, and so on. So, I invested in an expensive set of survey beacons.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Then, I scaled the mountain with a team of explorers. I was just putting the beacons in place when we were set upon by a huge group of monsters — they came out of nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: I didn't manage to grab them all before I left. The explorers insisted that we leave immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: They also said they're not going back up there any time soon... But what about my beacons? The monsters will smash them to pieces!

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Can you go and collect them for me? Please, I promise they're very easy to find.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Alright then...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Thank you a thousand times over! No, a million times!

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What's in this for me?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... a reward, of course! I'll make it worth your while, I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: So, thanks in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Ugh, just as I expected... With only a limited number of beacons, the accuracy is nowhere near good enough. There's no way I can use this as a reliable altitude measurement.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Unless...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: ...Unless?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Unless a fearless adventurer can scale the highest peak and place a beacon there for me.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: Like you! Please, help me out one more time. All my other beacons keep getting destroyed by monsters, so this is the only way to reduce the margin of error in my measurements.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: All you need to do is place it at the summit. If you succeed, I promise I will reward you generously!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about this mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Oh, interested in Dragonspine, are you? Interesting. You might have some potential as a geographer...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: I became a researcher out of curiosity concerning the source of Springvale's spring water — that source turned out to be the melting snow of Dragonspine.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: In order to study Dragonspine's environment more deeply, I prepared some Frostshield Potions, but it turns out the cold here is so intense that even potions are useless against it...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: They serve no purpose with me, so I reckon that you should take them. They won't be enough to resist the cold here on Dragonspine, but they might be of use in your future adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: I never thought that I would see such a sight in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you mumbling about?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. I'm an environmentalist and researcher of geography. I'm currently investigating the terrain here.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: To find a snow-capped mountain right here in Mondstadt, given the climate in the rest of the region, is really quite fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: I've seen similar circumstances elsewhere in the past, such as the Chasm in Liyue, so there may be some similarities in their respective terrain features...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: I wanted to go up the mountain to do some proper research, but I was stopped by that Knight of Favonius. A real spoilsport, that one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Alright, take care now.
